title: Agreement on the Establishment of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (full text)
notes: Reputation digital-policy NGO republication of the treaty text; signing facts corroborated by gov.cn/Xinhua (source 113). Cited for WAICO governance structure and treaty terms under Social (comparison table). Issues: Fetched text truncated at Article 14.2 (entry-into-force not captured).
claims: WAICO established as an independent intergovernmental international organization with international legal personality
Headquarters in Shanghai, PRC; structure: Council + Secretariat
Functions limited exclusively to the civilian domain of AI; convergence with the UN framework process
Decision-making: consensus to the furthest extent possible, else two-thirds majority of members present and voting; one state one vote
Secretary General and two Deputy Secretaries General, 3-year terms
Financing: annual contributions per scale of assessment referencing Universal Postal Union contribution classes
Membership open to all states; signature open May 1 - July 31, 2026
